{
    "content": "<p>Thus far in using Ubuntu, I've been able to use only Linux applications. I'll\nadmit that some of them were just ports of their Windows or Mac OS X\ncounterparts...but I never had to install wine (a compatibility layer for\nrunning Windows programs). Well you know that torrent app I recommended?\nkTorrent? It's crashed on me several times in the last couple days...and ate up\nevery bit of memory the system had this morning. I went looking for a better\nalternative and my only choice was to use uTorrent under wine. No\nproblem!</p>\n<p>Wine is only a synaptic click away. Running utorrent under\nit is a simple affair too. I found this tutorial\n<em>very</em> helpful:\n<a href=\"http://www.ubuntuforums.org/showthread.php?t=191161\">Using utorrent with wine - Ubuntu Forums</a></p>\n<p>However, since my primary monitor is a\n32&quot; LCD and I'm at about an 8-10 foot distance from it - the font size needs to\nbe increased. Under windows this is a simple task...but under Wine = not so\nmuch. I think this is something that NEEDS to be put into the wine configuration\napp. Anyway - here's how it's done.</p>\n<p>First - close any applications that are running under wine.</p>\n<p>To change the size of any menu font - you'll need to edit the win.ini under the following\nfolder: <code>/home/yourusername/.wine/</code></p>\n<p>Add the following information to the win.ini file:</p>\n<pre><code>[Desktop]\nMenuFontSize=18\n</code></pre>\n<p>You can change the 18 to whatever size you need - but that worked for me. Now we\nneed to change font size of the rest of the application. To do so, use the\nterminal and launch wine's regedit:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-sh\">wine regedit\n</code></pre>\n<p>You'll want to browse to this value:</p>\n<pre><code>HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG\\Software\\Fonts\\LogPixels\n</code></pre>\n<p>and change it to something larger. Make sure to change the selection to &quot;Decimal&quot;,\nas you probably don't natively speak hex. It's default in decimal is 96. I upped\nmine to 120 and it worked nicely. When you're done doing that, close\nout regedit and restart your wine application. Enjoy your larger font sizes and\nlack of squinting!</p>\n<p>Here's the best resource I found on this matter after a bit of searching:\n<a href=\"http://www.winehq.com/pipermail/wine-users/2005-April/017810.html\">http://www.winehq.com/pipermail/wine-users/2005-April/017810.html</a></p>\n",
